card.architecture: Krea 2 Turbo (8-step distilled; Qwen3-VL 4B encoder, Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE) + yijunwang2 AnyPaint LoRA on the ComfyUI-Krea2-AnyPaint nodes. The mask is not a conditioning channel: a full-canvas 384px semantic reference drives Krea 2's reference attention (with an isolated K/V cache), and known tokens are pinned every denoise step via a token-aligned noise mask, so unpainted pixels are preserved without any paste-back composite.
card.summary: Arbitrary-mask inpainting on Krea 2 Turbo. Paint any shape — or several disconnected regions — and one LoRA regenerates them to match the surrounding scene while every unpainted pixel is kept exact. Distilled Turbo: 8 steps, no CFG, no negatives.
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 Community License for your use
card.pick_when: You want Krea 2's aesthetic for a masked fill/replace/repair, arbitrary or multi-region masks, and preservation without seam-composite artifacts.

prompt.guidance: Describe the WHOLE intended picture (the finished composition), not just the patch and not an instruction — AnyPaint conditions on the full canvas.
prompt.example: a complete coherent photograph of a sunlit kitchen with a ceramic bowl of lemons on the island, consistent lighting and perspective
prompt.instructions: Natural language describing the complete result. 8 steps, euler/simple, cfg 1. No negative prompts.

negative.note: Distilled few-step (cfg 1 / guidance 0); negatives don't work.

speed.note: 12B-class Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, plus the reference K/V precompute. Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Paint the area(s) to change and describe the whole picture you want. Unpainted pixels are preserved automatically.
ui_help.good_for: arbitrary-shape or multi-region inpaint, object replacement, and repair in Krea 2's look

edit_use_cases: arbitrary-mask inpaint: regenerate any painted shape (or several) so it matches the surrounding scene, keeping every pixel outside it
